item.title: Alcohol ban, same drinking as Pattaya’s Saturday night moves to homes and hotel rooms
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Pattaya City authorities have announced a temporary ban on the sale and distribution of alcoholic beverages this weekend, in line with election laws and national regulations aimed at maintaining public order. According to the announcement, the prohibition will be in effect from 6:00 p.m. on Saturday, February 7, until 6:00 p.m. on […]

item.title: A waste of paint where green lights exist and pedestrians get hurt in Pattaya
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – For many foreign visitors and long-term residents, walking in Pattaya has become less about right of way and more about survival. item.title: Thailand warns of rain on Feb 8 as voters head to polling stations
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – The Thai Meteorological Department (TMD) has advised voters to be prepared for rain when traveling to polling stations on February 8, as wet weather is expected in several parts of the country. Forecast rainfall is likely across the Central and Eastern regions, the South, and Bangkok and its surrounding areas. The conditions […]

item.title: Pattaya basks in sunshine as cooler weather spreads across Thailand
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Thailand’s Meteorological Department (TMD) reported that a moderate cold air mass from China is spreading across upper Thailand, bringing cool to cold conditions in many areas, while Pattaya and the eastern region experience cooler mornings with generally fair weather. item.title: Thailand promotes POLICE CARE app to help citizens avoid online scams
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – The government is encouraging the public to download the POLICE CARE mobile application to help prevent online fraud by allowing users to check suspected scam bank accounts and phone numbers before incurring financial loss. The effort seeks to reduce the harm caused by online deception, which continues to affect many people nationwide. […]

item.title: Pattaya Mayor accelerates Sukhumvit Road lighting upgrade to improve safety
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand –Mayor Poramet Ngampichet has pressed ahead with efforts to improve road safety, inspecting progress on the installation of new street lighting along Sukhumvit Road between the South Naklua junction and Khlong Nok Yang, Feb 3. item.title: After Pattaya Mayor’s inspection, Jomtien waters clear and tourists return
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Pattaya City authorities have taken swift legal and corrective action following a public outcry over the discharge of wastewater into the sea at Jomtien Beach, confirming that seawater quality has now returned to normal and tourists have resumed swimming, while legal proceedings against the contractor are underway. item.title: Pattaya Police question beer bar guards after viral clash leaves tourist injured
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Pattaya police have taken four security guards from a beer bar in Pattaya in for questioning following the circulation of a viral video showing a violent confrontation with a foreign tourist, an incident that has sparked widespread concern over safety and the city’s tourism image. item.title: Pattaya’s dangerous roads put motorcyclists at daily risk
item.description: PATTAYA, Thailand – Pattaya’s roads continue to pose serious dangers for motorcyclists, with accidents occurring almost daily as riders contend with uneven surfaces, poorly marked obstacles, and heavy traffic flows.
